statusLine.command: bash -c 'plugin_dir=$(ls -d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/claude-hud/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); runtime=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || command -v node 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$runtime" ] && exit 0; rt="${runtime##*/}"; if [ "$rt" = "bun" ]; then exec "$runtime" --env-file /dev/null "${plugin_dir}src/index.ts"; else exec "$runtime" "${plugin_dir}dist/index.js"; fi'
